title: Yellow · countdown
description: Voucher expiry reminders. Number = days remaining (merge field).
usage: Urgency hero. The number is the hero asset. Deadline-driven sends only. Locked layout — edit only text.
notes: The number is static live text (Calibri Bold 160/160) in its own table cell — populate it with a days-remaining merge field / AMPscript at send time.
A live, ticking countdown requires a timer-GIF vendor (e.g. Sendtric, MotionMail, NiftyImages): replace the number cell with the vendor's and keep 'DAYS LEFT' as text.
Figma keeps the number at 160px on mobile; there is no mobile class for it, so it stays 160px (fits 3 digits at 375px).
Mobile (≤480px): eyebrow 28→24 (f24); side padding 48→32 (mobPad32), top 48→40 (padd-top), bottom 48→30 (mob-pad-bot) vs Figma's 32; 16px gaps → 10 (padd-none) vs Figma's 8.
